item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Rare song - Girl Thing - So You Wanna Have Sex
item.description: hello! i've been searching for this very rare girl thing song up and down the internet and i can't really find, besides a 30 second snippet that was on some canadian teen pop compilation. it's totally fine if no one can find it, since it's a long shot, but apparently CDrs with the song exist so i thought it could be possible someone here could have it. thank you so much luvs.
